purpose: Six authored get-up keyframes per guardian type, transparent PNG atlases, 3 columns x 2 rows.

assets.name: Neutral
assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: production 2D game sprite animation sheet. The supplied image is a CHARACTER IDENTITY AND HAND-DRAWN ART STYLE reference, not an edit target. Create a NEW six-frame get-up-from-defeat animation sheet for ONLY this exact wooden guardian character. Preserve wood grain, ink contours, navy fabric, proportions, face mask, equipment. NOT pixel art, NOT 3D. Transparent background, absolutely NO backdrop, floor, shadow, aura, captions, frame lines or labels. Layout STRICTLY 3 equal columns by 2 equal rows, six square cells, ideally 1536x1024 (each cell 512x512). Each cell contains ONE COMPLETE character, facing right in side/three-quarter gameplay view. Same camera, character size and ground baseline 90% of cell height, center of hips x=50% of cell. Consistent body anatomy size across frames; crouched frames naturally shorter than standing frame, DO NOT enlarge crouching frames. Leave clear margins, no part touching neighboring cells. Read left to right top row then bottom row. Frame1: lying defeated on side, head low. Frame2: pushes chest off floor with a hand, legs still folded low. Frame3: rises onto one knee, leans on weapon/support arm. Frame4: plants front foot and raises hips, torso still hunched. Frame5: almost upright, knees slightly bent, lifting head, cloth trailing. Frame6: fully upright balanced combat-ready stance with weapon low, powerful but calm. These are consecutive keyframes of ONE get-up motion, NOT attacks. Keep weapons in all frames, no invented extra limbs or swords. Anatomy and identity consistent. The reference is the basic slender light wood puppet swordsman with a rectangular blank wood face, round black joints, navy head ribbons and waist sash, short wood-slat skirt, one curved katana. Keep this basic identity.
